questions.stem: What provides the force that drives ultrafiltration in the glomerulus?

options.text: Active transport by the cells of Bowman's capsule
Osmosis caused by a water potential difference
High blood pressure in the glomerular capillaries
Diffusion of waste products down a concentration gradient

questions.explanation: Ultrafiltration is driven by high blood pressure in the glomerulus. The afferent arteriole is wider than the efferent arteriole, which builds up pressure and forces small molecules out of the blood into Bowman's capsule.
